trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for HEALTHCARE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- appointment_scheduling: Book, reschedule and cancel outpatient consultations against real doctor availability.
- insurance_preauth: Progress cashless pre-authorisation for planned and emergency admissions against policy limits.

Business context:
- appointment_scheduling: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.
- insurance_preauth: Indian multi-speciality hospital contact centre. Patients call about slots, reports and cashless approvals; clinical advice is out of scope and must be refused.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [appointment_scheduling]
  - No clinical advice: The agent must never suggest a diagnosis, a medicine or whether a symptom is serious. It may only route to a department.
  - Slot truth: Only slots returned by check_doctor_availability may be offered; never an approximate day.
  - Registration first: An unregistered patient cannot be booked; registration must be completed first.
  - Fee disclosure: The consultation fee quoted must be the one the slot carries.
  [insurance_preauth]
  - No approval promise: Only the insurer approves. The agent may say a request was submitted, never that it will be approved.
  - Network gate: Cashless is only available at a network hospital; otherwise the claim is reimbursement.
  - Balance truth: The payable estimate must come from the policy balance and the package estimate, never from arithmetic the agent invents.
  - Waiting period: A procedure inside an active waiting period cannot be submitted as cashless.

Tools available to you (7): book_appointment, check_doctor_availability, estimate_procedure_cost, lookup_patient_record, lookup_policy_coverage, submit_preauth_request, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: kn-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: book_appointment
model_visible_tools.description: Confirm a consultation slot and issue a booking reference.

model_visible_tools.name: check_doctor_availability
model_visible_tools.description: List free consultation slots for a doctor or department over the next days.

model_visible_tools.name: estimate_procedure_cost
model_visible_tools.description: Return the hospital's package estimate for a procedure, and what the policy would leave payable.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_patient_record
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve patient registration, department history and any open appointment.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy_coverage
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve insurer, sum insured, room-rent cap, waiting periods and remaining balance.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_preauth_request
model_visible_tools.description: Submit a cashless pre-authorisation request to the insurer.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: State the intent to book a follow-up appointment.

steps.purpose: Initiate identity verification by asking for the first factor.
steps.text: ನಾನು appointment book ಮಾಡೋಕೆ help ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ. ನಿಮ್ಮ account verify ಮಾಡೋಕೆ, ನಿಮ್ಮ registered name ಹೇಳ್ತೀರಾ?

steps.purpose: Ask for the second verification factor.
steps.text: ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು. ನಿಮ್ಮ date of birth ಕೂಡ confirm ಮಾಡ್ತೀರಾ?
ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು ರಮೇಶ್ ಅವರೇ. ನಾನು ನಿಮ್ಮ details check ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ.

steps.purpose: Confirm registration and state intent to check availability.
steps.text: ನಿಮ್ಮ record verify ಆಗಿದೆ. ನೀವು cardiology department ಗೆ visit ಮಾಡಿದೀರಾ. Next week ಗೆ doctor availability check ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ.
Next week ಗೆ ಎರಡು slots available ಇದೆ. Dr. Sharma ಅವರ slot Tuesday 10:00 AM ಗೆ ಇದೆ, ಮತ್ತು Dr. Patil ಅವರ slot Wednesday 11:30 AM ಗೆ ಇದೆ.

steps.purpose: Select a slot and ask for the fee.
steps.text: Tuesday 10:00 AM slot ಓಕೆ. ಒಂದು ನಿಮಿಷ, fee ಎಷ್ಟಾಗುತ್ತೆ?

steps.purpose: Restate figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
steps.text: ಓಕೆ, fee 800 rupees ಅಲ್ವಾ? ಮತ್ತು ಇದು Dr. Sharma ಅವರ slot ತಾನೇ?

steps.purpose: Confirm the details and ask for booking confirmation.
steps.text: ಹೌದು, fee 800 rupees ಮತ್ತು ಇದು Dr. Sharma ಅವರ slot. ನಾನು ಇದನ್ನ book ಮಾಡ್ಲಾ?

steps.purpose: Ask a clarifying question before agreeing.
steps.text: ಒಂದು doubt ಇತ್ತು, ಇದು cardiology department ಗೆ ತಾನೇ? ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ tension ಆಗ್ತಿದೆ, ಅದಕ್ಕೆ ಕೇಳ್ತಾ ಇದೀನಿ.

steps.purpose: Reassure user and ask for final confirmation.
steps.text: ಹೌದು, ಇದು cardiology department ಗೆ ಸಂಬಂಧಿಸಿದ appointment. ಈಗ Tuesday 10:00 AM slot confirm ಮಾಡ್ಲಾ?

steps.purpose: Provide booking reference and confirm appointment.
steps.text: ನಿಮ್ಮ appointment confirm ಆಗಿದೆ. Booking reference B-9988. Dr. Sharma ಅವರ ಜೊತೆ Tuesday 10:00 AM ಗೆ appointment ಇದೆ.
ಓಕೆ, ನನ್ನ ಬುಕಿಂಗ್ ರೆಫರೆನ್ಸ್ B-9988, Tuesday 10:00 AM ಗೆ ಇದೆ ಅಂತ ಕನ್ಫರ್ಮ್ ಆಯ್ತು. ತುಂಬಾ ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು.

ir.terminal_condition: Appointment confirmed with a booking reference, doctor, day, time and fee.

prompt_backfill.note: Generated under a workflow-scoped prompt: the agent was told its workflow rather than inferring it.

variant_findings.reason: The agent correctly prioritizes identity verification (e8) before calling the patient record tool (e11) and disclosing the patient's past department visit (e13), successfully demonstrating step completion validation.
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Step sequencing adherence > Step Completion Validation

variant_findings.reason: The agent violates the negative constraints of the variant by making an unsupported forward guarantee in e22 ('ಖಂಡಿತ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ, ನೀವು appointment ನ reschedule ಅಥವಾ cancel ಮಾಡಬಹುದು' - 'Certainly, you can reschedule or cancel'), which is a claim about post-call possibilities not returned by any tool.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: In e22, the agent guarantees that the user can cancel or reschedule the appointment later. This violates the Tool Output Grounding variant, which strictly prohibits guarantees about what happens after the call ends. Additionally, in e23, there is a script typo where the user says 'ಲುಕ್ ಮಾಡಿ' (look maadi) instead of 'ಬುಕ್ ಮಾಡಿ' (book maadi), which is not marked as an STT error.
issues.repair_instruction: Rewrite from e21. Have the user ask a clarifying question that can be answered using existing tool data (e.g., verifying if the appointment is indeed for the cardiology department) while still expressing tension to satisfy the persona. In e22, the agent should reassure the user by confirming the grounded detail without making policy guarantees. In e23, correct the user's text to 'ಸರಿ, ಬುಕ್ ಮಾಡಿ' (Okay, book it).

verification.summary: The conversation correctly enforces identity verification before record retrieval, satisfying the step sequencing variant. However, the agent fails the Tool Output Grounding variant by making an unsupported guarantee about future cancellation/rescheduling policies. Additionally, a minor Kannada typo ('ಲುಕ್' instead of 'ಬುಕ್') appears in the user's confirmation. A suffix repair is required to align the clarifying question with tool-grounded facts and fix the typo.

variant_findings.reason: The agent correctly prioritizes identity verification by asking for knowledge factors and calling the verification tool before looking up the patient record or disclosing any account-specific history (such as the previous cardiology visit).
variant_findings.label: Task Following > Step sequencing adherence > Step Completion Validation

variant_findings.reason: Every specific detail mentioned by the agent (department, slot times, doctors, fee, and booking reference) is strictly grounded in the preceding tool outputs without any hallucinations or unverified forward guarantees.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

verification.summary: The conversation is well-constructed and strictly adheres to the workflow, business rules, and persona constraints. The agent successfully verifies the user's identity before accessing and disclosing personal information, and all provided details are perfectly grounded in tool outputs. The persona's anxious traits are naturally integrated, and the language accurately reflects the NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH requirement.
